types.name: ReactionOption
types.doc: A reaction bar for comments, posts, and release notes. Each pill shows one reaction and how many people chose it; the viewer's own reactions carry the accent. Tapping a pill adds or removes the viewer's reaction, and the add button opens a compact picker that grows from it. Use it for quick acknowledgement; when people need to say something specific, give them a reply field instead.

members.name: options
members.doc: Every reaction the picker offers, in picker order.

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled reactions. Pills keep this order, and a reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.

members.name: onValueChange
members.type: (next: Reaction[], change: { id: string; reacted: boolean }) => void
members.doc: Called with the next reactions and the change that produced them.

members.name: open
members.doc: Picker open state; omit it to let the bar manage its own open/closed state.

members.name: container
members.doc: Render the picker inside this element and limit collisions to it (used by the demo stages).

members.name: onOpenAutoFocus
members.doc: Called before the picker moves focus in on open; call event.preventDefault() to keep focus where it is (for a picker that starts open).
